---
title: "History"
---

```{python}
from datetime import date

import polars as pl
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_blank,
    geom_area,
    geom_line,
    geom_point,
    geom_text,
    geom_tile,
    geom_vline,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_manual,
    scale_y_continuous,
    scale_y_reverse,
    scale_fill_gradient,
    scale_x_continuous,
    theme,
    theme_classic,
)

runs_by_year_df = pl.read_csv("../data/derived/runs_by_year.csv")
runs_by_month_df = pl.read_csv(
    "../data/derived/runs_by_month.csv", try_parse_dates=True
)
heatmap_text_threshold = runs_by_month_df["total_distance_miles"].quantile(0.7)
pace_text_threshold = runs_by_month_df[
    "aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile"
].quantile(0.3)
pace_seconds = pl.col("aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile").round().cast(pl.Int64)
monthly_heatmap_df = runs_by_month_df.with_columns(
    pl.col("month").dt.year().alias("year"),
    pl.col("month").dt.month().alias("month_number"),
    pl.col("total_distance_miles").round().cast(pl.Int64).alias("distance_label"),
    pl.concat_str(
        [
            (pace_seconds // 60).cast(pl.String),
            pl.lit(":"),
            (pace_seconds % 60).cast(pl.String).str.pad_start(2, "0"),
        ]
    ).alias("pace_label"),
    pl.when(pl.col("total_distance_miles") >= heatmap_text_threshold)
    .then(pl.lit("light"))
    .otherwise(pl.lit("dark"))
    .alias("distance_text_color"),
    pl.when(pl.col("aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile") <= pace_text_threshold)
    .then(pl.lit("light"))
    .otherwise(pl.lit("dark"))
    .alias("pace_text_color"),
)

age_40_date = date(2023, 11, 9)
age_40_year = age_40_date.year + (
    (age_40_date - date(age_40_date.year, 1, 1)).days
    / (date(age_40_date.year + 1, 1, 1) - date(age_40_date.year, 1, 1)).days
)


def format_pace_labels(values):
    labels = []
    for value in values:
        minutes, seconds = divmod(round(value), 60)
        labels.append(f"{minutes}:{seconds:02d}")
    return labels


def add_age_40_marker(chart, period: str):
    if period not in {"year", "month"}:
        return chart

    xintercept = age_40_year if period == "year" else age_40_date
    return chart + geom_vline(
        xintercept=xintercept,
        color="#343a40",
        linetype="dashed",
        size=0.8,
    )


def distance_chart(data: pl.DataFrame, period: str):
    chart = (
        ggplot(data, aes(x=period, y="total_distance_miles"))
        + geom_area(fill="#0d6efd", alpha=0.14)
        + geom_line(color="#0d6efd", size=1)
        + scale_y_continuous(
            labels=lambda values: [f"{value:,.0f}" for value in values]
        )
        + labs(
            x=None,
            y="Distance (mi)",
            caption=(
                "Dashed line: turned 40 on November 9, 2023."
                if period in {"year", "month"}
                else None
            ),
        )
        + theme_classic()
    )
    if period == "year":
        chart += geom_point(color="#0d6efd", size=2)
    return add_age_40_marker(chart, period)


def pace_chart(data: pl.DataFrame, period: str):
    chart = (
        ggplot(data, aes(x=period, y="aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile"))
        + geom_line(color="#0dcaf0", size=1)
        + scale_y_reverse(labels=format_pace_labels)
        + labs(
            x=None,
            y="Moving pace (min/mi)",
            caption=(
                "Dashed line: turned 40 on November 9, 2023."
                if period in {"year", "month"}
                else None
            ),
        )
        + theme_classic()
    )
    if period == "year":
        chart += geom_point(color="#0dcaf0", size=2)
    return add_age_40_marker(chart, period)
```

## Year

### Distance

```{python}
distance_chart(runs_by_year_df, "year")
```

### Pace

```{python}
pace_chart(runs_by_year_df, "year")
```

## Month

### Distance

```{python}
distance_chart(runs_by_month_df, "month")
```

### Pace

```{python}
pace_chart(runs_by_month_df, "month")
```

## Monthly Heatmaps

### Mileage by Calendar Month

```{python}
month_labels = [
    "Jan",
    "Feb",
    "Mar",
    "Apr",
    "May",
    "Jun",
    "Jul",
    "Aug",
    "Sep",
    "Oct",
    "Nov",
    "Dec",
]
heatmap_years = monthly_heatmap_df["year"].unique().sort().to_list()

(
    ggplot(
        monthly_heatmap_df,
        aes(
            x="year",
            y="month_number",
            fill="total_distance_miles",
        ),
    )
    + geom_tile(width=0.95, height=0.95)
    + geom_text(
        aes(label="distance_label", color="distance_text_color"),
        size=6,
        show_legend=False,
    )
    + scale_fill_gradient(low="#edf4ff", high="#0d6efd")
    + scale_color_manual(values={"dark": "#1f2937", "light": "white"})
    + scale_x_continuous(breaks=heatmap_years[::2])
    + scale_y_reverse(breaks=range(1, 13), labels=month_labels)
    + labs(
        x="Year",
        y="Month",
        fill="Distance (mi)",
        caption="Each cell shows total miles; blank cells fall outside the recorded range.",
    )
    + theme_classic()
    + theme(axis_ticks=element_blank())
)
```

### Pace by Calendar Month

```{python}
(
    ggplot(
        monthly_heatmap_df,
        aes(
            x="year",
            y="month_number",
            fill="aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile",
        ),
    )
    + geom_tile(width=0.95, height=0.95)
    + geom_text(
        aes(label="pace_label", color="pace_text_color"),
        size=6,
        show_legend=False,
    )
    + scale_fill_gradient(
        low="#0d6efd",
        high="#b8daff",
        labels=format_pace_labels,
    )
    + scale_color_manual(values={"dark": "#1f2937", "light": "white"})
    + scale_x_continuous(breaks=heatmap_years[::2])
    + scale_y_reverse(breaks=range(1, 13), labels=month_labels)
    + labs(
        x="Year",
        y="Month",
        fill="Moving pace",
        caption="Each cell shows aggregate moving pace; darker is faster.",
    )
    + theme_classic()
    + theme(axis_ticks=element_blank())
)
```
